units.source_text: 他说：“我以前辞去京都而退居到这乡间，都是为了你。

en.t: He said, "Long ago I left Kyoto and withdrew to this countryside entirely for your sake.

units.source_text: 实指望在此当国守，可以早晚随心所欲地教养你。

en.t: I truly hoped that by serving here as provincial governor, I could raise and teach you as I wished, morning and evening.

units.source_text: 岂知就任之后，由于时运不济，身逢种种患难。

en.t: But after I took office, my fortunes failed, and I met with all kinds of hardships.

units.source_text: 若再返京都，只是一个潦倒的老国守，无法改善蓬门陋室的贫苦生涯。

en.t: If I returned to Kyoto, I would only be a ruined old governor, unable to improve our poor life in a humble dwelling.

units.source_text: 在公私两方，都赢得了一个笨伯的恶名；而辱及先人令名，尤可痛心。

en.t: In both public and private affairs I earned the shameful name of a fool, and what pains me most is that I have disgraced the good name of my ancestors.

units.source_text: 我辞去京都之时，人都预料我将出家。

en.t: When I left Kyoto, everyone expected that I would take holy orders.

units.source_text: 我自己也觉得世间名利恭敬都已不惜放弃。

en.t: I myself felt that I could give up worldly fame, profit, and honor without regret.

units.source_text: 但目睹你年事渐长，知识渐开，又觉得我岂可将此美锦藏在暗中。

en.t: But as I saw you grow older and your understanding open, I thought, how could I hide such beautiful brocade away in the dark?

units.source_text: 为子女而悲痛的父母之心，永无晴朗之时。

en.t: A parent's heart that grieves for a child never has a clear and sunny hour.

units.source_text: 于是求神拜佛，但愿自身虽然命穷，切勿连累子女，听其沦落在山乡之中。

en.t: So I prayed to the gods and bowed before the Buddhas, hoping that even if my own fate was exhausted, I would not drag my child down and leave her to decline in a mountain village.

units.source_text: 长抱此志，以待将来。

en.t: I held this wish for a long time and waited for the future.

units.source_text: 果然事出意外，与源氏公子结了良缘，真乃可喜之事。

en.t: Then, quite unexpectedly, you formed a blessed bond with Prince Genji, which was truly a joyful thing.

units.source_text: 但因身份相去太远，念及汝身前程，又不免东顾西虑，徒增悲叹。

en.t: Yet because the difference in rank was so great, when I thought of your future I could not help worrying in every direction and only added to my sorrow.

units.source_text: 后来生了这小宝贝，方信姻缘前定，宿根不浅。

en.t: Later, when this little treasure was born, I finally believed that the marriage bond had been fixed beforehand and that your karmic ties were deep.

units.source_text: 教她在这海边过日子，太委屈了。

en.t: It is far too unfair to make her live out her days by this seashore.

units.source_text: 我想这孩子的命运一定与众不同。

en.t: I think this child's destiny must be unlike that of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 我今后不能见她虽觉可悲，但我身既已决心与世长遗，也就顾不得许多了。

en.t: It saddens me that I will not be able to see her from now on, but since I have already resolved to leave the world behind forever, I can no longer concern myself with so much.

units.source_text: 我这小外孙女身上有荣华富贵之福相。

en.t: This little granddaughter of mine bears the signs of splendor, wealth, and good fortune.

units.source_text: 她偶尔生在这乡间，暂时惑乱我这村夫的心目，也是前世因缘吧。

en.t: That she happened to be born in this countryside and for a time bewildered the heart and eyes of this rustic man must also be a bond from a previous life.

units.source_text: 我好比天上神仙偶尔堕入三途恶道，暂时生受一番痛苦，今天便要与你们永别了。

en.t: I am like an immortal from heaven who happened to fall into the three evil paths, endured suffering for a little while, and today must part from you forever.

units.source_text: 将来你们听到我的死耗，也不须为我追荐。

en.t: In the future, when you hear news of my death, there is no need to hold memorial rites for me.

units.source_text: 古语云：‘大限不可逃’，切勿为此伤心！”

en.t: As the old saying goes, 'One cannot escape the appointed end'; do not grieve over this!"

units.source_text: 他说得语气很坚决。

en.t: He spoke in a very resolute tone.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“我在化为灰烟以前，在昼夜六时的祈祷中，还要附带为我这小宝贝祝福。

en.t: Later he added, "Before I turn into ash and smoke, in my prayers at the six hours of day and night, I will also include blessings for this little treasure of mine.

units.source_text: 我这一点尘心尚未断绝呢。”

en.t: This small worldly attachment of mine has not yet been severed."

units.source_text: 说到小外孙女，他又要哭了。

en.t: When he spoke of his little granddaughter, he was about to cry again.
